preamble: Each domain question draws from the complete medical record. Points reflect diagnostic weight. Cost reflects typical test burden: Small = existing record / standard labs  |  Medium = targeted test or genetic panel ($200–$1,500)  |  Large = biopsy or advanced testing ($1,500–$10,000+)

questions.question: Is there episodic gross hematuria (cola/dark urine) concurrent with or within 1–3 days of an upper respiratory infection (synpharyngitic pattern)?
questions.confirmingAnswer: Yes — synpharyngitic hematuria confirmed; onset during or within 1–3 days of URI

questions.question: Is persistent microscopic hematuria (≥3 RBC/HPF) documented on ≥2 separate urinalysis reports?
questions.confirmingAnswer: Yes — persistent glomerular hematuria confirmed on serial UA

questions.question: Is there sub-nephrotic proteinuria (0.5–3.5 g/24hr or PCR 0.5–3.0 mg/mg)?
questions.confirmingAnswer: Yes — sub-nephrotic proteinuria in typical IgAN range

questions.question: Does temporal documentation confirm hematuria onset within 1–3 days of URI (distinguishing IgAN from post-strep GN at 2–4 weeks)?
questions.confirmingAnswer: Yes — interval ≤3 days confirmed in clinical notes; IgAN-consistent timing

questions.question: Are there ≥2 documented episodes of URI-triggered hematuria in the clinical record?
questions.confirmingAnswer: Yes — recurrent URI-triggered hematuria pattern confirmed

questions.question: Is the patient a young adult (age 15–35 years at onset), with male predominance?
questions.confirmingAnswer: Yes — age 15–35 at first presentation; high-probability IgAN demographic

questions.question: Is serum IgA level elevated (>400 mg/dL on immunoglobulin panel)?
questions.confirmingAnswer: Yes — serum IgA elevated; present in 30–50% of IgAN patients

questions.question: Are serum C3 and C4 complement levels both normal? (normal complement distinguishes IgAN from post-infectious GN and MPGN)
questions.confirmingAnswer: Yes — C3 and C4 normal; supports IgAN over post-infectious or complement-mediated GN

questions.question: Are RBC casts and/or dysmorphic RBCs confirmed on manual urine microscopy?
questions.confirmingAnswer: Yes — dysmorphic RBCs or RBC casts confirm glomerular origin of hematuria

questions.question: Are ANCA (MPO/PR3) and anti-GBM antibodies both negative?
questions.confirmingAnswer: Yes — ANCA-vasculitis and Goodpasture's disease excluded

questions.question: Are ANA and anti-dsDNA negative (excludes lupus nephritis)?
questions.confirmingAnswer: Yes — lupus nephritis excluded; ANA <1:80 and anti-dsDNA negative

questions.question: Is ASO titer normal with no recent group A streptococcal infection ≥3 weeks prior?
questions.confirmingAnswer: Yes — post-streptococcal GN excluded; ASO normal and URI timing ≤3 days supports IgAN

questions.question: Is there dominant or codominant IgA staining (≥2+ brighter than all other immunoglobulins) in the mesangium on immunofluorescence?
questions.confirmingAnswer: Yes — dominant mesangial IgA confirmed on IF; DEFINITIVE for IgAN diagnosis

questions.question: Is there mesangial hypercellularity on light microscopy (Oxford M1 score) and documented Oxford MEST-C score?
questions.confirmingAnswer: Yes — mesangial proliferation confirmed; Oxford MEST-C score available for prognostication

high.label: 🔴  80–100 High confidence
high.action: IgAN confirmed or highly probable; initiate RAS blockade (ACE/ARB) targeting BP <130/80 mmHg and proteinuria <0.5 g/day; consider sparsentan (FDA approved 2023) for high-risk proteinuria; biopsy confirmation recommended for Oxford MEST-C prognostication and treatment decisions

moderate.label: 🟡  50–79 Moderate confidence
moderate.action: Probable IgAN; biopsy strongly recommended; begin RAS blockade and SGLT-2 inhibitor while awaiting histology; complete complement, ANCA, and ASO workup if not done

low.label: 🟢  <50 Low confidence
low.action: IgAN unlikely or insufficient data; evaluate other causes of hematuria and proteinuria (post-infectious GN, ANCA vasculitis, thin basement membrane disease); complete serology and urinalysis workup
